description: This file defines a Twitch outbound adapter for sending messages and media to Twitch chat channels, implementing the ChannelOutboundAdapter interface with functions for resolving targets, sending text, and sending media (via URLs).

methods.name: resolveTarget
methods.description: Resolves and validates the target Twitch channel based on input parameters, allowlist, and mode.

methods.name: sendText
methods.description: Sends a text message to a specified Twitch channel, with markdown stripping and account validation.

methods.name: sendMedia
methods.description: Sends media (URL) to a Twitch channel by embedding it in a text message, since direct media uploads are not supported.
